name: Card
description: Composable contained surface for cards, modal bodies, drawers, popovers, toasts, and grouped content.

title.description: Heading of the card header, rendered through Card.Title. With `title`, `description` or `footer` set, children fill the content part.

description.description: Secondary text under the title, rendered through Card.Description.

footer.description: Footer content: text, elements, component descriptors or arrays of them.

variant.description: Surface role: a standard contained surface, an unframed composition (`plain`) or a code canvas (`code`). Default: default.

padding.description: Inner surface inset, from the standard 7px rhythm down to flush. Default: default.

radius.description: Corner geometry for contained, compact, dialog or flush surfaces. Default: md.

border.description: Draw the surface border, independently of padding, radius and variant. Default: true.

hoverable.description: Highlight the surface on hover or focus within; does not create an action.

fullWidth.description: Stretch to the available inline size; `false` fits the content and keeps the parent's alignment. Default: true.

footerAlign.description: Alignment of the `footer` content; compound usage sets `Card.Footer align` instead. Default: end.

children.description: Body of the card: the content part beside `title`/`description`/`footer`, or free composition of Card parts.

props.title: Card Title
props.children: Workspace settings and recent activity stay grouped in one place
Unframed content for composition inside another surface.

props.title: Deploy preview
props.children: The surface highlights on hover or focus within; its children own their actions.

notes: Card is the shared contained-surface shell for other composed components.
Card separates visual surface presets from behavior; Modal still owns dialog behavior and can render its body through Card.
Title, description, string children and footer strings render through Text; Button descriptors receive membranes by default.
The surface background is layered over an underlay token so transparency stays stable across parent backgrounds.

whenToUse: Shared contained surface for Modal, Popover, Toast, and gallery examples
whenNotToUse: Clickable list item by itself (use Button or Tile for interaction semantics)
Full-page layout container without a contained surface role
Dialog behavior by itself (use Modal; Modal may compose Card internally)
